title: Perimeter, Area & Volume
description: Book-backed practice on perimeter, area, composite shapes, prisms, surface area, volume, and contextual measurement problems.

questions.q: A trapezium drawn on a grid contains $24$ full squares and $8$ half-squares. Find its area in square units.
questions.explanation: Eight half-squares make $4$ full squares. Total area is $24+4=28$ square units.

questions.q: A rhombus has four equal sides, each about $12$ cm. Find its perimeter.
questions.explanation: A rhombus has four equal sides, so its perimeter is $4\times12=48$ cm.

questions.q: Find the perimeter of a parallelogram with base $12$ cm and side $8$ cm.
questions.explanation: Perimeter of a parallelogram is $2(a+b)=2(12+8)=40$ cm.

questions.q: Find the area of a parallelogram with base $10$ cm and perpendicular height $5$ cm.
questions.explanation: Area of a parallelogram is base times perpendicular height: $10\times5=50$ cm$^2$.

questions.q: Find the perimeter of a trapezium whose side lengths are $12$ mm, $13$ mm, $14$ mm, and $18$ mm.
questions.explanation: Add all four sides: $12+13+14+18=57$ mm.

questions.q: Find the area of a trapezium with parallel sides $3$ in and $6.8$ in, and height $3.8$ in.
A kite has diagonals $72$ m and $89$ m. Find its area.
A kite has adjacent side lengths $51$ m and $64$ m. Find its perimeter.
questions.explanation: For a kite with two pairs of equal adjacent sides, perimeter is $2(51+64)=230$ m.

questions.q: A rhombus is split into four congruent triangles, each with area $7.5$ cm$^2$. Find the area of the rhombus.
questions.explanation: The rhombus area is four times one triangle: $4\times7.5=30$ cm$^2$.

questions.q: A parallelogram has perimeter $48$ cm. Two opposite sides are $16$ cm each. Find each of the other sides.
A garden is a parallelogram with sides $12$ m and $9$ m. How much fencing is needed?
questions.explanation: Fencing follows the perimeter: $2(12+9)=42$ m.

questions.q: The same parallelogram garden has base $12$ m and perpendicular height $8$ m. Find its area.
questions.explanation: Area is base times perpendicular height: $12\times8=96$ m$^2$.

questions.q: A rhombus logo has diagonals $96$ cm and $60$ cm. Find its area.
A banner is $150$ cm by $100$ cm. A centred rhombus logo has height $60$ cm. Find the blank space above the logo.
questions.explanation: Vertical blank space is $150-60=90$ cm, split equally above and below: $45$ cm above.

questions.q: A parallelogram-shaped glass pane has base $50$ cm and perpendicular height $40$ cm. Find its area.
A rhombus-shaped flower bed has diagonals $12$ m and $8$ m. Find its area.
A trapezium-shaped ramp has parallel sides $2$ m and $5$ m, and height $1.5$ m. Find its area.
A decorative kite has diagonals $2.5$ m and $1.5$ m. How much material is needed?
A field in the shape of a rhombus has area $60$ m$^2$. One diagonal is $12$ m. Find the other diagonal.
A rectangular deck is $8$ m by $6$ m. Find its area.
questions.explanation: Area of the deck is $8\times6=48$ m$^2$.

questions.q: A parallelogram tile has base $1.2$ m and perpendicular height $0.8$ m. Find the area of one tile.
A $48$ m$^2$ deck is covered with parallelogram tiles of area $0.96$ m$^2$. How many full tiles are needed?
questions.explanation: Number of tiles $=48\div0.96=50$.

questions.q: A rectangular floor is $6$ m by $4$ m. Each parallelogram tile has area $0.15$ m$^2$. How many tiles are needed?
questions.explanation: Floor area is $6\times4=24$ m$^2$. Tiles needed $=24\div0.15=160$.

questions.q: A parallelogram-shaped roof has base $10$ m and perpendicular height $4$ m. Find its area.
questions.explanation: Area $=10\times4=40$ m$^2$.

questions.q: A rhombus-shaped foundation has diagonals $30$ m and $24$ m. Find the land area covered.
A trapezium-shaped plot has parallel sides $40$ m and $70$ m, and height $30$ m. Find its area.
A kite-shaped plot has diagonals $10$ m and $6$ m. Find its area.
Which statement correctly describes a prism?
options: A solid with two identical parallel bases and a constant cross-section
A circle with a centre and radius
A shape with only one face
questions.explanation: A prism has two identical parallel bases, and the cross-section remains constant along its length.

questions.q: A triangular prism has how many faces, edges, and vertices?
questions.explanation: A triangular prism has $2$ triangular faces and $3$ rectangular faces, making $5$ faces, $9$ edges, and $6$ vertices.

questions.q: A cuboid has a square base of side $4$ m and height $10$ m. Find the total surface area.
questions.explanation: Two square faces give $2(4^2)=32$ m$^2$, and four rectangular faces give $4(4\times10)=160$ m$^2$. Total is $192$ m$^2$.

questions.q: Find the volume of a triangular prism with base area $64$ cm$^2$ and height $7$ cm.
questions.explanation: Volume of a prism is base area times height: $64\times7=448$ cm$^3$.

questions.q: Find the volume of a rectangular prism with length $6$ yd, width $8$ yd, and height $15$ yd.
questions.explanation: Volume $=6\times8\times15=720$ yd$^3$.

questions.q: A popcorn box holds $7,000$ cm$^3$. Its base is $14$ cm by $20$ cm. Find its height.
questions.explanation: Base area is $14\times20=280$ cm$^2$. Height $=7000\div280=25$ cm.

questions.q: A prism has volume $324$ cubic units and height $9$ units. Find its base area.
questions.explanation: Since $V=BH$, $324=9B$, so $B=36$ square units.

questions.q: A swimming pool is a cuboid with length $10$ m, width $5$ m, and depth $2$ m. How much water does it hold?
questions.explanation: Volume $=10\times5\times2=100$ m$^3$.

questions.q: A square prism has height $11$ yd and volume $99$ yd$^3$. Find the side length of the square base.
questions.explanation: Base area $=99\div11=9$ yd$^2$. For a square base, side length is $\sqrt{9}=3$ yd.

questions.q: A prism has a triangular base with base $12$ m and height $16$ m. If the prism length is $20$ m, find its volume.
questions.explanation: Triangular base area $=\frac{1}{2}(12)(16)=96$ m$^2$. Volume $=96\times20=1,920$ m$^3$.

questions.q: A cylinder has radius $3$ m and height $6$ m. Using $\pi=\frac{22}{7}$, find its volume.
questions.explanation: Volume of a cylinder is base area times height: $\pi r^2h=\pi(3^2)(6)=54\pi$ m$^3$.

questions.q: A cylinder has radius $3$ m and height $6$ m. Find its total surface area in terms of $\pi$.
questions.explanation: Total surface area $=2\pi r^2+2\pi rh=2\pi(9)+2\pi(3)(6)=18\pi+36\pi=54\pi$ m$^2$.

questions.q: Which unit is appropriate for measuring the volume of a water tank?
questions.explanation: Volume measures three-dimensional space, so it is measured in cubic units such as m$^3$.
